title: Find Missing Elements
description:
You are given an array nums with unique integers.

The numbers originally formed a continuous range
Some numbers may be missing
The smallest and largest values are still present
Task

Return all missing numbers between:

min(nums) → max(nums)
Output should be sorted
If no numbers are missing → return:
[-1]
input_format:
The first line contains an integer n.
The second line contains n space-separated integers.
output_format: Print space-separated integers in one line.
constraints:
2 ≤ n ≤ 100
1 ≤ nums[i] ≤ 100
All elements are unique
